en.headline: New mortgage approvals fall 28 percent in August
en.dek: The Monetary Authority said banks approved HK$32.2 billion of home loans last month, while drawdowns rose and arrears stayed low.
body: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority said on Wednesday that residential mortgage loans approved in August fell 28.2 percent from July to HK$32.2 billion.

Within that total, approvals tied to primary-market purchases dropped 31.8 percent to HK$9.1 billion and those for secondary-market deals fell 36.7 percent to HK$15.3 billion. Refinancing approvals rose 6.8 percent to HK$7.8 billion. New applications declined 8.3 percent to 8,446.

Loans actually drawn down increased 11.6 percent to HK$32.8 billion. The share of new loans priced off HIBOR slipped from 61 percent in July to 57 percent, while the share priced off best lending rates edged up from 1.3 percent to 1.9 percent.

Outstanding mortgage balances stood at HK$1,975.4 billion at the end of August, up 0.6 percent on the month. The authority said the delinquency ratio remained low at 0.11 percent and the rescheduled-loan ratio was still close to zero.

zh.headline: 八月新批住宅按揭買款按月跌28%
zh.dek: 金管局公布新批額減至322億元，新取用反升至328億，拖欠比率仍低於0.11%。
body: 香港金融管理局星期三公布，八月份新批出的住宅按揭買款額較七月減少28.2%，至322億港元。
其中涉及一手市場交易的買款減少31.8%至91億元，二手市場減少36.7%至153億元；轉按買款則增加6.8%至78億元。新申請個案按月減少8.3%，至8,446宗。
同期新取用按揭買款額反增11.6%，至328億元。以銀行同業拆息定價的新批買款佔比由7月的61%降至57%，以最優惠買款利率定價的佔比由1.3%升至1.9%。
截至8月底，未償還按揭買款總額按月增加0.6%，至1萬9,754億元。金管局指拖欠比率維持0.11%的低水平，經重組買款比率仍接近0%。
